+++ b/README.md
@@ -1 +1,18 @@
 # fixture repo
+
+## Running the tests
+
+Tests run with [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/):
+
+```sh
+pip install pytest
+pytest
+```
+
+Test files live alongside the modules they cover, named `test_*.py`
+(for example, `test_pricing_cache.py`). To run a single file or test:
+
+```sh
+pytest test_pricing_cache.py
+pytest test_pricing_cache.py::test_lookup_falls_back_to_snapshot
+```
